onboard.p_purpose_t: FOCA-rs is a tool for lawful security auditing and open-source intelligence (OSINT): finding published documents, analysing their metadata and checking your own resources.
onboard.p_warranty_t: The app is provided “as is”, without any warranty, under the GNU GPL version 3 license. Results may be incomplete or wrong.
onboard.p_dev_t: The developer is not liable for any direct or indirect damage, data loss, or violation of laws or third-party rights resulting from the use of the app.
onboard.p_user_t: You alone are responsible for what, where and how you check.
onboard.p_active_t: Requests to target servers, port scans, vulnerability checks and zone transfers are only for your own resources or with the owner's written permission. The app asks you to confirm this before every active run.
onboard.p_criminal_t: Unauthorized access to other people's information systems and interference with their operation may be a criminal offence. In Ukraine this is, in particular, Article 361 of the Criminal Code; other countries have their own laws.
onboard.p_pii_t: Documents contain names, logins, email addresses and phone numbers. You are responsible for complying with data protection laws: collect only what you need, store it securely, delete it when the work is done.
onboard.p_device_t: Projects, documents and reports are stored encrypted on this device only. The app sends no telemetry or usage statistics.
onboard.p_third_t: Requests to web archives, certificate transparency (CT) logs, search APIs and the AI service with your key are made on your behalf and from your address (or through your proxy). You are responsible for following their terms of use.
onboard.p_logs_t: Logs are stored locally. They are exported only on your command, with keys and passwords scrubbed.
onboard.p_changes_t: If the terms change, the app will show them again and ask you to accept the new version.
onboard.check_read: I have read and accept the terms

onboard.check_resp: I, not the developer, am responsible for how it is used
onboard.declined_text: The app cannot be used without accepting the terms. Close the app or go back to the terms.
onboard.terms_lead: Read the terms before you start. It takes a couple of minutes
onboard.lawful: FOCA-rs is for lawful checks only.
onboard.lawful_text: Check your own resources or resources you have the owner's written permission for.
onboard.why_read: Read the terms to the end
onboard.not_accepted: The current version of the terms has not been accepted yet.
onboard.oem_autostart_t: Security › Apps › Permissions › Autostart › FOCA-rs, turn on. Otherwise the system stops the scan after you leave the app.
onboard.oem_activity_t: Settings › Apps › FOCA-rs › Activity control › “No restrictions”.
onboard.oem_recents_t: During a scan FOCA-rs hides from Recents, so the card cannot be swiped away (Settings › Background execution). If you turn hiding off, lock the card instead: long-press it and tap the lock.
onboard.oem_samsung_t: Settings › Apps › FOCA-rs › Battery › “Unrestricted”. Remove the app from “Sleeping apps”.
onboard.oem_huawei_t: Settings › Battery › App launch › FOCA-rs. “Manage manually”, turn on all three switches.
onboard.oem_oneplus_t: Settings › Apps › FOCA-rs › Battery › “Allow background activity”.
onboard.perms_lead: All optional: declining breaks nothing, you can change it in Settings › Background work
onboard.notif_why: Show scan progress while the app is minimized, with a “Stop” button. They tell Android that work is running in the background.
onboard.batt_why: Exemption from battery optimization: a long scan will not be cut off when the screen is off.
onboard.oem_fail: The vendor settings screen did not open. Find the item manually using the hint
